gate: EXPERIENCE_START_P_V1 - does a start p chosen from verified past precision experience cut the total retry cost while correctness is unchanged?
classification: FCC_N SCENARIO FAMILY - NOT THE 2/3-ATOM CERTIFICATION SCOPE

baseline.parent: claude/selector-service-v1 @ e018090 (local; origin/claude/selector-service-v1 = 0e6953b, local 1 commit ahead, checked)
baseline.this_branch: claude/experience-start-p-v1 in the main checkout (no worktree); clean, no untracked files at start

terms.lowest_observed_success_p: the lowest p among the passes actually run (and verified) that ended DECIDED
terms.highest_observed_failure_p: the highest p among the passes actually run (and verified) that did not end DECIDED
terms.forbidden: minimum_required_p / true_minimum_p are never written: no p was searched exhaustively below the observed success

reused_unchanged: E2 rw:R1+R2, CPU serial / parallel runners (experiments/w5_placement_v1/run), ExecutionPlan, Selector V1 (experiments/selector_service_v1/selector.select, frozen including its N=8 boundary error), P2 (experiments/precision_pilot_a1/policies.next_p / p2_next), FCC_N generation, cell readout, cycle CPU, load rule, GPU reserved name

contracts.physics_contract_hash: sha256 over the sorted 'path:sha256_lf' lines of exact_expression_gate_v1/stream.py, exact_expression_gate_v1/common.py, exact_expression_gate_v0/lang_iv.py, a_reference/ar2_lang2024.py
contracts.training_side: computed from the source_sha256_lf table recorded in the training evidence's execution_seal.json (the code that produced the evidence)
contracts.evaluation_side: computed from the files at campaign start; memory is trusted only if both hashes are equal

experience_keys.level1_exact: request_fingerprint = sha256(physics_contract_hash, numeric_contract_hash, evaluator, initial_state_digest, T); N is recorded but the initial-state digest is the identifier
experience_keys.level2_family: ('FCC_N', T, evaluator, physics_contract_hash, numeric_contract_hash); T values never mixed; no other scenario family

experience_store.training_bundle: built once from the training source evidence only: one ExperienceRecord per executed pass (service passes and shadow passes; probes have no passes); verification_status = VERIFIED only if the source checker verdict is EVIDENCE OK; per exact key: lowest_observed_success_p, highest_observed_failure_p; per family: FAMILY_MIN = min over exact keys of lowest_observed_success_p, FAMILY_MAX = max of the same. Only VERIFIED records enter any summary.
experience_store.seal: the bundle file and its sha256 are committed before any policy code; the campaign verifies the hash at load and refuses to run if it differs
experience_store.read_only: the store is never written during the campaign; evaluation passes are written to separate candidate_experience files that no policy reads; they become dataset candidates only after the independent checker
experience_store.no_online_update: no result of this campaign changes any decision of this campaign

policies.EXACT_MEMORY: start p = lowest_observed_success_p of the exact key if present in the sealed bundle, else 64 (miss)
policies.FAMILY_MIN: start p = FAMILY_MIN of the family key if present, else 64
policies.FAMILY_MAX: start p = FAMILY_MAX of the family key if present, else 64
policies.after_first_pass: identical for all policies: the unchanged P2 (p2_next, cap 1024) decides every later p; final when DECIDED / STOP; REFUSED_AT_CAP when P2 returns CAP
policies.no_correctness_role: a policy only picks the first p; acceptance is the unchanged DECIDED readout

worker_selector: Selector V1 frozen, goal WALL_MIN (main comparison); CPU of every pass recorded

part_A_exact_replay.note: the same requests as the training bundle: this measures reuse of experience for the identical job and is NOT evidence of generalization

part_B_unseen_N.candidate_check: a search over every docs/active/**/records.json.gz found no FCC_N record (any experiment, any p) with these (N, T); the first-priority list is used unchanged
part_B_unseen_N.exact_memory: the EXACT_MEMORY lookup is recorded for every Part B request and must be a miss (the checker verifies); it is not executed separately because a miss is the P2_BASE plan

order: Part A then Part B; per repetition requests in the listed order; within a request the policies rotated by repetition index
serial_reference: after both parts, one CPU_SERIAL pass for every distinct (N, T, p) that any policy ran (Part A p values must also equal the SELECTOR_SERVICE_V1 serial passes at the same (N, T, p))
correctness_hard_gate: every pass bit-identical (outcome, completed_steps, stop, stop_step, cells, endpoints_key, initial-state digest) to the serial reference at the same (N, T, p); a policy that changes any final result fails
cost_metrics_per_service_run: overshoot = starting_p - lowest_observed_success_p (training value; only for Part A keys that have one)
experience_sample: one per service run: pre_run_features {N, T, pair_count, evaluator, topology_class, physics_contract_hash, numeric_contract_hash, initial_state_digest}; attempts [{p, outcome, completed_steps, backend, workers, cpu_s, wall_s}]; observed_summary {highest_observed_failure_p, lowest_observed_success_p, total_service_wall_s, total_service_cpu_s}; no true-minimum label. Recommended future target: the start p that minimizes the expected total service cost, not a minimum-p prediction.

decision_rules_sealed.EXACT_MEMORY_useful_candidate: no correctness difference, first-pass success in >= 5 of the 6 Part A requests (all clean repetitions), and median total service wall reduced by >= 20 % vs P2_BASE in >= 5 of 6; labelled reuse, not generalization
decision_rules_sealed.FAMILY_MIN_generalization_candidate: first-pass success in >= 4 of the 5 Part B requests (all clean repetitions) and median total wall AND CPU lower than P2_BASE in >= 4 of 5
decision_rules_sealed.FAMILY_MAX_service_candidate: median total wall AND CPU lower than P2_BASE in >= 4 of 5 Part B requests, and lower than FAMILY_MIN in >= 3 of 5
decision_rules_sealed.both_unstable: if neither family rule qualifies: no model is built; more diverse experience is collected first

cost_estimate: from the SELECTOR_SERVICE_V1 probe (~1 ms per pair-step serial, p 64-256 within ~15 %): Part A ~ 900 CPU s, Part B ~ 2,200 CPU s, serial references ~ 700 CPU s; cap 8,000 CPU s (cycle-counted); the campaign stops at the next run boundary when exceeded
load_rule: unchanged from E2_PAIR_PARALLEL_V1 (others >= 1 logical CPU or python/roblox/codex/node >= 25 % -> CONTAMINATED; kept, checked, excluded from performance numbers)
fault_injection_tests: unverified experience used as trusted memory
experience from another physics/evaluator contract mixed in
exact memory with a different initial-state digest
a result of this campaign used by a later request
claims_forbidden: lowest_observed_success_p is the minimum required p
amendment_1_before_any_run: Before the code seal, on the desktop (scratch; desktop load groups CONTAMINATED by the sealed rule): the test fixture and one dry run used Part A N = 5, T = 100 (a training request whose outcome is already in the bundle) and Part B N = 6, T = 100 (NOT an evaluation request; never in the training bundle). Seen: N = 5 P2_BASE 64 -> 106, EXACT_MEMORY first pass at 106 DECIDED; N = 6 P2_BASE 64 -> 107, FAMILY_MIN (106) and FAMILY_MAX (109) DECIDED at the first pass; all passes bit-identical to serial references. This is disclosed because it is family-level information about a neighbouring N; the Part B requests, policies, rules and thresholds were already sealed and are unchanged. Defect found by the clean-fixture test and fixed before the seal: the checker compared the bundle record count with a count of distinct p values instead of records.
